shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut, switching to a full-frame eye-level shot with lateral tracking, moving through a broken doorway into the conference floor. Two teddy bears sit opposite each other across a rusted table—the red-tied teddy on the left foreground, the opponent teddy in the right midground, and the gray rabbit secretary standing slightly behind and to the right, forming a triangular composition. Cracks on the table and fallen folders act as leading lines toward both parties. Sand still infiltrates the room, broken blinds casting intermittent striped shadows, and the plush surfaces gently flutter in the breeze.
shot3: Shot 3 cuts sharply to a close-up eye-level shot, focusing on a water purification chip inside an old briefcase. The blurred front lid frames the shot, while the two teddies in the background appear only as pixelated silhouettes. The chip emits a faint cyan-blue glow, contrasting sharply with surrounding rust stains. The shock-absorbing foam inside has aged and cracked. The camera pushes in extremely slowly, accompanied by a clearer metallic creak, clearly establishing the chip as the core of the negotiation.
shot4: Shot 4 cuts sharply to a close-up eye-level push-in on the red-tied teddy, occupying the left half of the frame, with the corner of the table and the blurred chip in the lower right creating directional pressure.
shot5: Shot 5 connects via a short hard cut, using a medium overhead shot with slight downward tilt. The gray rabbit secretary steps forward from the side of the table and steadily pushes a worn contract from the right edge of the frame to the center. In the foreground, the red-tied teddy’s furry paw rests on the edge of the table; in the background, the opponent teddy subtly tenses. The paper edges curl, pixel-style stamp area and clause lines are clearly visible.
shot6: Shot 6 cuts sharply to an overhead close-up of the tabletop, where several old batteries are arranged like stakes, surrounded by the contract, chip case, and a metal seal, forming a tense geometric relationship. Light slants diagonally through the broken window, highlighting scratches and oxidation marks on the battery casings under high-saturation pixel blocks. A gust of wind enters through a crack, causing paper corners to flutter.
shot7: Shot 7 cuts sharply to a close-up eye-level shot of the opponent teddy, using a slightly off-shoulder composition that blurs the red-tied teddy’s shoulder in the left foreground, creating a reverse-angle setup.
shot8: Shot 8 transitions via a quick lateral cut, shifting to a medium-wide side-view tracking shot. The camera slides from the table to the broken window, transitioning focus from indoor negotiation to the approaching sandstorm. The broken window frame creates strong vertical division. Outside, a wall of yellow-brown sand rolls forward, distant ruins gradually swallowed. Occasional lightning flashes coldly behind clouds.
